parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame is the main structural body of the dishwasher, made of stainless steel for durability and corrosion resistance.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and houses all internal components such as racks, spray arms, and the motor.
parts.Movement_description: The frame is fixed and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Door
parts.Basic_description: The door is the front panel of the dishwasher, typically made of stainless steel with an insulated inner layer.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the interior for loading and unloading dishes and seals tightly during operation to prevent water leakage.
parts.Movement_description: The door pivots downward on hinges and can be opened or closed manually.

parts.name: Side Controls
parts.Basic_description: The side controls are the interface components located on the front or side of the dishwasher, made of durable plastic.
parts.Functional_description: They allow the user to select washing modes, start or stop cycles, and adjust settings.
parts.Movement_description: The control knobs or buttons can be pressed or rotated to operate the dishwasher.
